in_hebrew.name: דורו
in_hebrew.long_meaning: A name derived from the Hebrew word 'dor', meaning 'generation' or 'age', this name signifies a precious gift or present from God.

in_greek.name: Δωρο
in_greek.long_meaning: In Greek, 'Doro' translates to 'gift'. This name was given to a child born during a time of great prosperity, symbolizing the blessings bestowed upon the family.

in_latin.name: Dorus
in_latin.long_meaning: The Latin form of 'Doro', 'Dorus', carries the same meaning as the original Hebrew and Greek. It was a name given to children born during times of abundance and joy.
